description.fun: Murkrow loves anything that sparkles and will fight other Pokémon for their stash, yet it sometimes gives its treasures to Trainers it likes. Its witchy look, with a crest like a pointed hat and a tail like a broom, and its habit of leading travellers astray on dark mountain paths have made it a symbol of bad luck. It's the only Pokémon that isn't a Ghost type to evolve with a Dusk Stone.
description.guide: A crow Pokémon of the Dark and Flying types, active at night, with a crest and tail that resemble a witch's hat and broom. It collects sparkling objects and is traditionally seen as a sign of bad luck. A Dusk Stone evolves it into Honchkrow.
description.tagline: A witch-hatted crow with a weakness for shiny things

description.fun: Honchkrow is a mob boss in feathers, with a fedora-like crest and a white 'cravat'. One cry summons a flock of over a hundred Murkrow to fetch its food or fight for it, and it steps in only for the finishing blow; failure and betrayal are never forgiven. A former Nintendo of America marketer has said one Generation 4 Pokémon was nearly called 'Doncrowleone', and going by its Japanese name, Dongkarasu, it was very likely this one.
description.guide: A large crow Pokémon of the Dark and Flying types, introduced in Generation 4 as Murkrow's evolution. Its feathers resemble a mob boss's fedora and cravat, and it commands flocks of more than a hundred Murkrow. It is nicknamed the 'Summoner of Night'.
description.tagline: The crow boss with a hundred Murkrow on call
